tasks.summary_pl: P-stwo losowania białej kuli (dwie urny, kostka)
tasks.summary_en: Probability of drawing a white ball (two urns, a die)
tasks.statement_en:
There are two urns with balls, each containing 5 balls. The first urn has 1 white ball and 4 black balls. The second urn has 3 white balls and 2 black balls. We roll a fair six-sided die once. If it shows one or two dots, we draw one ball from the first urn; if it shows at least three dots, we draw one ball from the second urn. The probability of drawing a white ball equals:
A. $\frac{1}{15}$
B. $\frac{2}{5}$
C. $\frac{7}{15}$
D. $\frac{3}{5}$

An infinite geometric sequence $(a_n)$ is given by the formula $a_n=\dfrac{3}{(\sqrt2)^n}$ for $n=1,2,3,\dots$. The sum of all terms of this sequence equals:
A. $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt2-1}$
B. $\dfrac{\sqrt2}{\sqrt2-1}$
C. $\dfrac{2}{\sqrt2-1}$
D. $\dfrac{3}{\sqrt2-1}$

tasks.notes: Poprawna odpowiedz to 3^2015, wartosc rzeczywista skonczona, ale przekracza zakres liczby zmiennoprzecinkowej IEEE-754 (~10^961.5) i nie da sie zapisac jako skonczona liczba JS.
Wybor opisu wzajemnego polozenia dwoch okregow (stwierdzenie).

tasks.summary_en: $|n|$ where $n$ is the smallest integer solving $2|x+57|=|x-39|$
tasks.statement_en: The number $n$ is the smallest integer satisfying the equation $2\cdot|x+57|=|x-39|$. Find $|n|$ (the task asks to encode the hundreds, tens and units digits of $|n|$).

tasks.statement_en: Calculate the limit of the sequence $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{3n^2-5n+2}{(8n+7)(n+4)}$.
The function $f$ is given by the formula $f(x)=\dfrac{x-8}{x^2+6}$ for every real number $x$. Calculate the value of the derivative of this function at the point $x=\dfrac12$.

tasks.notes: Udowodnij, ze kat ma miare 60 stopni (dowod).
Udowodnij nierownosc dla kazdego x i m (dowod).

tasks.statement_en: Janek performs a random experiment in which the outcome can be one of the numbers $0,1,2,3,4,5,6$. The probability $p_k$ of obtaining the number $k$ is given by the formula $p_k=\frac{1}{64}\binom6k$. Consider two events: event $A$ - obtaining a number from the set $\{1,3,5\}$; event $B$ - obtaining a number from the set $\{2,3,4,5,6\}$. Calculate the conditional probability $P(A|B)$.

tasks.notes: Zbior wartosci parametru m to suma przedzialow: m<0 lub m>12/5.
Wyznacz rownanie stycznej do paraboli (rownanie, nie liczba).
Objetosc wyrazona wzorem V=(a^3/6)*sqrt(tan^2(alpha)-1), zalezna od nieustalonych a i alpha (wyrazenie, nie liczba).

tasks.statement_en: Points $M$ and $L$ lie on sides $AB$ and $AC$ of triangle $ABC$, respectively, such that $|MB|=2|AM|$ and $|LC|=3|AL|$. Point $S$ is the intersection of segments $BL$ and $CM$. Point $K$ is the intersection of ray $AS$ with segment $BC$ (see figure). [Figure: triangle $ABC$ with $M$ on side $AB$, $L$ on side $AC$, cevians $BL$ and $CM$ meeting at $S$, and ray $AS$ extended to meet $BC$ at $K$.] The area of triangle $ABC$ equals $660$. Calculate the areas of triangles $AMS$, $ALS$, $BMS$ and $CLS$.

tasks.statement_en: Calculate how many 100-digit natural numbers have a digit sum equal to $4$.

tasks.summary_pl: Pudełko z kartonu: bok naroża i max. objętość (suma)
tasks.summary_en: Box from cardboard: corner side and max volume (sum)
tasks.statement_en: A rectangular sheet of cardboard measuring $80\text{ cm}$ by $50\text{ cm}$ is given. Square corners are cut out from the four corners of this sheet (see figure). The cardboard is then folded along the dashed lines, forming an open rectangular box (without a lid). Calculate the side length of the cut-out square corners for which the volume of the resulting box is greatest. Calculate this maximum volume.
